Chapter 519: Chapter 15 No Harm, The Galaxy Master Is Watching Us, Just Fight Freely (Ask For Subscription)

Chapter 519: Chapter 15 No harm, the Galaxy Master is watching us, just fight freely (ask for subscription)

The stone statue Shen Ji had already greatly overestimated Lin Yuan.

Over two thousand years old—

Cultivated to the Eighth Layer.

Comprehended dozens of Cosmic Forces.

And more than ten high-level Cosmic Forces.

There was also a Source-level Cosmic Force.

...

Such a monstrous freak, no matter which universe it was placed in,

would be deemed shockingly unconventional and utterly unique.

But even so, how could he comprehend the Space Rules so quickly?

Those aren’t ordinary rules, they’re pillar rules!

The stone statue Shen Ji found it unbelievable, it knew that the “Void Interpretation” left by the Moyu Tower Master would definitely bring great help to Lin Yuan.

But at most, it was only help, it wasn’t the Moyu Tower Master himself comprehending the Space Rules, mainly it still depended on Lin Yuan himself.

The “Void Interpretation” was profound and difficult to understand, if one couldn’t comprehend it, instead of helping, it might even make things worse.

“How can there be such…”

The stone statue Shen Ji muttered to itself, seemingly unable to find the words to describe Lin Yuan.

…..

The Second Layer of the Black Tower.

Lin Yuan used Absolute Space to isolate the inside from the outside, diluting and dispelling all the pressure that enveloped him.

He quickly crossed one third of the distance.

As he delved deeper, the pressure all around became increasingly heavy and terrifying.

One by one, ethereal creatures condensed, lunging at Lin Yuan with bared fangs and brandished claws.

“I can’t hold back anymore.”

Lin Yuan’s heart sank, and he immediately began to activate Cosmic Force.

It was as if an endless pressure swept over him, and even with Absolute Space, it was difficult to completely isolate it, requiring the use of stronger measures.

Huu…

One after another, the Cosmic Forces combined, with more than ten high-level Cosmic Forces as the main body, and the Primordial Origin Force as the core, all Cosmic Forces perfectly merged into one.

For years, Lin Yuan had often used the pressure of the Second Layer of the Black Tower to hone himself, to refine his use of Cosmic Force, naturally not without gain.

This method of merging all Cosmic Forces was Lin Yuan’s greatest achievement, allowing the power of each type of Cosmic Force to nearly double in strength.

Boom, boom, boom.

Lin Yuan, under the attack of one ethereal creature after another, strode towards the center.

…

Outside the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

Stone Statue Shen Ji paid close attention to the situation in the Second Layer of the Black Tower.

“If he’s relying solely on these, it would be very difficult to get through the Second Layer…”

Stone Statue Shen Ji whispered to itself, it used ‘very difficult’ to express its opinion.

Very difficult, but not impossible.

After witnessing Lin Yuan’s short period of comprehending the Complete Space Rules, Stone Statue Shen Ji didn’t dare to be too certain about anything for fear of being proven wrong later.

There was no helping it, Lin Yuan had already created too many miracles.

So now it took any view with a degree of uncertainty.

“The pressure towards the back of the Second Layer will grow ever greater…”

Stone Statue Shen Ji thought to itself, many Ninth Rank beings could often traverse the first two-thirds of the distance.

But in the last third, they would be crushed, leading to a failed trial.

With the manner Lin Yuan was exhibiting, he was very likely to end up much like those Ninth Rank beings who failed their trials.

After all, Ninth Rank lives that could break through the Second Layer of the Black Tower found the first two-thirds of the journey quite easy.

…

The Second Layer of the Black Tower.

Lin Yuan’s steps increasingly slowed, and when he reached the last third of the distance, the horrifying pressure felt almost tangible, filling every inch of the vacuum.

“Without using the ‘Strengthening’ Divine Ability, it’s very difficult for me to penetrate the Second Layer with my own strength.”

Lin Yuan inwardly sighed, with the Black Tower’s Second Layer proving itself to be especially prepared for Ninth Rank lives. He had comprehended the Complete Space Rules and mastered so many Cosmic Forces,

yet there was no hope to break through.

“Let’s see further.”

“Walk a few more steps.”

“If the timing is right, then use the ‘Strengthening’ Divine Ability.”

Lin Yuan reigned in his thoughts, as such Divine Ability could only be maintained for the duration of ten breaths, so he had to get as close as possible; otherwise, he would be terribly at a loss if the Divine Ability’s duration ended and he was just a bit short of breaking through.

The ‘Strengthening’ Divine Ability was not the same as Absolute Space or Cosmic Force; it required Lin Yuan to pay a significant short-term price.

You wouldn’t want to fail to get through the Second Layer and then find yourself weakened.

Boom, boom, boom.

Lin Yuan trudged painfully through.

After half an hour, he arrived at a position about fifty meters from the central area.

At this point, Lin Yuan could almost be described as unable to take a step further, with the extreme pressure locking him firmly in place.

If it weren’t for Absolute Space and the many merged Cosmic Forces isolating him, Lin Yuan guessed he would be crushed in an instant.

“Only fifty meters left…”

“That’s enough.”

Lin Yuan steadied his spirit and slowly closed his eyes.

At the same time.

On the Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s true body opened his eyes.

Woom.

Threads of crimson aura intertwined and collided, forming a complex Divine Ability Imprint.

As soon as this Divine Ability Imprint appeared, it quickly fused into Lin Yuan’s Physical Soul, and in an instant, his physical vitality began to surge, increasing tenfold in strength.

The physical body drove the soul, and the soul drove the Spirit Will, and in a moment, all of Lin Yuan leapt tenfold.

In the Demon Jade Space.

The Second Layer of the Black Tower.

The moment he actively activated the ‘Strengthening’ Divine Ability,

this thread of Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will also surged tenfold.

As a result, the might of his Absolute Space, the power of dozens of Cosmic Forces, all soared at once.

The ‘Strengthening’ Divine Ability only affected aspects like Lin Yuan’s Physical Soul and Spirit Will, it didn’t enhance the power of rules or forces like Cosmic Force.

But the increase in Spirit Will affected these aspects nonetheless.

Spirit Will is fundamental; for example, the same level of perception of the Space Rules, when wielded by an Eighth Layer being as opposed to a Ninth Rank being, produces a wholly different level of might.
